## Summary

Migrated the entire Pages Router app to the App Router on Next.js 16, added TypeScript types throughout, and removed the pages/ directory entirely. next build passes (TypeScript + static generation, 15 routes generated).

### File mapping

| Pages Router | App Router | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| pages/_app.js + pages/_document.js | app/layout.tsx | Merged into one root layout with <html lang="en"><body>, AppProvider, shared header/nav/footer, global CSS import, metadata + viewport exports, and the Inter font via next/font/google (replacing the _document <link> tags) |
| pages/_error.js | app/error.tsx + app/global-error.tsx | getInitialProps is gone. error.tsx is a Client Component error boundary with typed error/retry props; global-error.tsx handles root-level uncaught errors (defines its own <html>/<body> per the docs) |
| pages/404.js | app/not-found.tsx | next/head → metadata export; useRouter from next/router → a small Client Component button using next/navigation (so the page can stay a Server Component and keep metadata) |
| pages/index.js | app/page.tsx + app/ViewAllPostsButton.tsx | getServerSideProps → async Server Component fetching directly + headers() for the user-agent; next/head → metadata; the router.push button extracted to a Client Component |
| pages/blog/index.js | app/blog/page.tsx + app/blog/ReadMoreButton.tsx | getStaticProps ISR → async Server Component with export const revalidate = 60; next/head → metadata; button extracted to a Client Component |
| pages/blog/[id].js | app/blog/[id]/page.tsx + loading.tsx + BackButton.tsx | getStaticPaths/getStaticProps → generateStaticParams + export const revalidate = 300; router.isFallback loading UI → loading.tsx; notFound: true → notFound(); next/head → generateMetadata; back button extracted to a Client Component |
| pages/api/posts/index.js | app/api/posts/route.ts | handler(req,res) GET/POST → GET/POST Route Handlers using NextRequest/NextResponse, await request.json(), NextResponse.json(..., { status }) |
| pages/api/posts/[id].js | app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts | req.query.id → RouteContext<'/api/posts/[id]'> with awaited ctx.params; GET/PUT/DELETE handlers |
| components/AppProvider.js | components/AppProvider.tsx | Typed context (AppContextValue, Theme) |

### Replaced Pages Router APIs (no longer in App Router)
- next/head → metadata / generateMetadata / viewport exports
- next/document (Html/Head/Main/NextScript) → root layout.tsx <html>/<body> + next/font
- next/router useRouter → next/navigation useRouter (client navigation buttons extracted into Client Components so pages stay Server Components)
- getServerSideProps → async Server Component + headers()
- getStaticProps (ISR revalidate) → export const revalidate segment config
- getStaticPaths → generateStaticParams
- router.isFallback → loading.tsx
- notFound: true → notFound() from next/navigation
- res.status().json() / req.body / req.query → NextResponse.json() / await request.json() / RouteContext params

Build verification: npx next build → exit 0, TypeScript passed, 15 static pages generated, ISR revalidate windows shown (/blog 1m, /blog/[id] 5m) matching the original revalidate: 60 and revalidate: 300.
